notes.title: Update 1.0.8
notes.notes:
[b]Update v1.0.8[/b] brings a lot of new content to Dinogen Online, including 2 new game modes!

[h2]General[/h2]
- Dinosaur growl sound effects now scale with their size
- Louder weapons (such as snipers and rocket launchers) have a larger sound radius for alerting bots
- When selecting [b]Random Game Mode[/b] or [b]Random Map[/b], the selection will now remain after each game
- Lots of UI updates
- Server optimizations

[h2]Game Modes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43392302/e6e8cc48966e03985c2d9e222f64e7480aacc0b7.png[/img]
- Added [b]Dinosaur Rescue[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43392302/0f965b57a447e85dd6f9f5c8667b665b222cf2bb.png[/img]
- Added [b]Extraction[/b]

[h2]Editor[/h2]
- Added new crates: [b]Class Selector[/b] and [b]Objective Crate[/b]
- Added support for dynamic building roofs
- Added support for sound emitters
- Added new road textures

[h2]Open World[/h2]
A new [b]Open World[/b] game mode is currently under development! A dedicated testing server is online for players. [url=https://discord.gg/jhdNu5kDrZ]Join the Discord[/url] to get involved!

[h2]Community Spotlight[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2989263281
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2926268462

notes.title: Patch Notes for June 7, 2023
notes.notes:
- Increased Airstrike and Napalm Airstrike explosive damage
- Added airstrikes to random airdrop crate [i](used in Evolution or with Random Airdrops enabled)[/i]
- Added separate menus when selecting a scenario, game mode, or map in Edit Game Settings
- Bots equipped with the Repair Tool will now repair friendly vehicles
- Bots will now interact with ammo boxes/ammo crates when low on ammo
- Bots in standard games will now be equipped with random equipment [i](rather than the class default)[/i]
- Increased LVOA-C damage from 30 to 32
- Mag Assist is now available for the Quadra from the Tactical Crate

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
[b]Update v1.0.6[/b] brings [b]Clans[/b] to Dinogen Online!

[h1]Clans[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43392302/ecd226d163ff7219611c7ceaadc77da9dc041e28.png[/img]
[b]Start earning more rewards by creating or joining a clan![/b]

Clan members have access to special clan challenges which award higher value rewards such as Shards, weapons, and character items.

Player clans are now displayed beside their name in multiplayer.

[h3]Clan Emblem[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43392302/28454dc70cd711058b8f9ad0cd61ac3e613408bc.png[/img]
Create a unique clan emblem using the [b]Emblem Editor[/b]!

[h3]Clan Leaderboards[/h3]
Clans earn [b]Clan XP[/b] when members earn XP, complete clan challenges, and win in public game lobbies.

[h3]Clan Leader[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43392302/83308306f7ca7756b35214665aa6f6c09c9cef90.png[/img]
Each clan is lead by a single [b]Clan Leader[/b] who manages the clan:
[list]
[*] Invite members
[*] Customize the clan emblem
[*] Upgrade the clan
[*] Add clan news and info
[/list]

[h1]Other Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] UI updates
[*] Network optimizations
[/list]
